title: Distro manifest
description: One distro's user-data, in src/manifests/<distro>.yml: the WSL distribution it's for and the fragments it's built from.

name.description: The WSL distribution's name, which is also the default instance name from wsl --install. The WSL datasource reads <name>.user-data only for an instance with this name.

version.description: The version of the release the distro's user-data is published in, in Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 without a v prefix. Every manifest has the same version. Bump it in every change that changes what's built into dist/.

description.description: A sentence saying what the distro's user-data is for.

fragments.description: Every fragment in the distro's user-data, keyed by position. cloud-init merges them in ascending order of their keys, which can have gaps. Each value is the name of a file in src/fragments/ without .user-data, with no number in front: the key sets the order. List each fragment once: the schema can't check that values are unique.
